Package com.csse3200.game.components.statuseffects

Class MagnetEffect

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.statuseffects.TimedStatusEffect
com.csse3200.game.components.statuseffects.MagnetEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatusEffect
public class MagnetEffect extends TimedStatusEffect
The condition the Magnet Potion puts on the player. While it runs, every Gold coin and consumable lying within radius of the player slides towards them, and is collected through the item's normal Item.pickUp(Entity) rule once it arrives.

Charms are deliberately left alone: picking a charm is a build choice the player should make themselves with the pickup key. While active, the player is drawn with a soft golden glow.

      public MagnetEffect(GameTime time, long durationMs, Entity owner, float radius, float pullSpeed, float collectDistance)
      Parameters:
      time - game clock used for the countdown and per-frame movement
      durationMs - how long the magnet lasts, in milliseconds
      owner - the entity that items are pulled towards (the player)
      radius - world-unit distance within which items are pulled
      pullSpeed - world units per second that items move towards the owner
      collectDistance - distance at which a pulled item is collected

    • getGlow

      public com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.Color getGlow()
      Description copied from interface: StatusEffect
      Returns the colour this effect adds on top of the sprite of whatever it is on, or null to add nothing. Unlike StatusEffect.getTint(), which multiplies and so cannot lighten a dark sprite at all (black times any colour is still black), a glow shows on every sprite in the game.

      Treat the returned colour as read only; the caller may be a renderer running every frame. Its alpha is the strength of the glow rather than a transparency.
